# lucidity_tenants (Data Source)

Lists every tenant (onboarded cloud account) under the caller's Lucidity account, ACTIVE first then INACTIVE. Enables a "desired vs actual" comparison against your lucidity_tenant resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lucidity_tenants" "all" {}

output "active_tenant_ids" {
  value = [
    for t in data.lucidity_tenants.all.tenants : t.tenant_id
    if t.status == "ACTIVE"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `tenants` (Attributes List) Every tenant under the account, ACTIVE first then INACTIVE. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tenants))

<a id="nestedatt--tenants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tenants`

Read-Only:

- `cloud_entity_name` (String) The provider-side account name.
- `cloud_provider` (String) AWS, AZURE, or GCP.
- `cloud_provider_account_id` (String) The cloud account id.
- `display_name` (String) The display name shown in the dashboard.
- `status` (String) ACTIVE, INACTIVE, or DECOMMISSIONED.
- `tenant_id` (String) Lucidity's identifier for the tenant.
